spanish: En la diligencia, no *sean* perezosos; ardan en el espíritu; sirvan al Señor.

adjudication.decision: **Razones de la traducción** - «En la diligencia» represents τῇ σπουδῇ and preserves the same noun translated as «diligencia» in 12:8. - «No» translates μή. - The Greek has the predicate adjective ὀκνηροί but no copula; therefore, «*sean*» is correctly supplied and italicized. - «Perezosos» expresses ὀκνηροί as reluctance, slowness, or laziness in diligent action. - «Ardan» translates ζέοντες and preserves its concrete image of boiling or burning rather than reducing it to the abstract «sean entusiastas». - «En el espíritu» preserves τῷ πνεύματι without deciding whether it refers to the human spirit or the Holy Spirit. - Because the immediate construction does not identify the referent unequivocally as the Holy Spirit, «espíritu» appropriately remains lowercase. - «Sirvan» renders the participle δουλεύοντες with the exhortational force governing this series. - «Al Señor» preserves the dative τῷ κυρίῳ.
